[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Ransen''' was a scholar of [[Ximology]]. Ransen suggested that ''[[The Despotica]]'' could have been initiated as [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] propaganda against [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].
